description.zh: 面向中小企业的销售数据分析。上传从 ERP、CRM、进销存或 Excel 导出的销售明细，自动识别字段和口径，分析业绩与目标达成、同比环比、客户 RFM 分层与流失预警、产品 ABC 分类与毛利、量价结构拆分、商机漏斗与预测，并生成销售周报月报。无需预先整理数据或连接系统。
description.en: Sales analysis for small and mid-sized businesses. Upload sales records exported from an ERP, CRM or spreadsheet; it works out the columns, then covers performance and targets, period comparisons, RFM customer segments and churn alerts, product ABC and margins, price-volume-mix, pipeline and forecasts, and weekly or monthly sales reports.

welcome_message.zh: 把销售明细表（Excel 或 CSV）发给我，告诉我你想知道什么。不用先整理，我会先看懂数据再分析。
welcome_message.en: Send me your sales records (Excel or CSV) and tell me what you want to know. No clean-up needed; I will read the data first.

description.zh: 销售额趋势、同比环比、销售排名

prompt.zh: 请分析我上传的销售数据：本期业绩怎么样，和上期、去年同期比变化多少，哪些销售人员、区域或产品贡献最大，变化主要来自哪里。
prompt.en: Analyze the sales data I uploaded: how did this period go, how does it compare with the previous period and last year, who or what contributed most, and where did the change come from.

description.zh: 按当前进度推算本月能完成多少

prompt.zh: 本月目标是（填写金额）。请根据目前的销售数据算出达成率和时间进度，并按近期日均推算月底大概能完成多少，给出乐观、中性、保守三种情况。
prompt.en: This month's target is (amount). From the sales so far, give the attainment and time elapsed, and project the month-end result in optimistic, base and conservative cases.

description.zh: RFM 分层，找出重点和要流失的客户
description.en: RFM segments, key and at-risk customers

prompt.zh: 请用 RFM 方法给我的客户分层，告诉我哪些是重要客户、哪些很久没下单可能要流失，并导出一份需要重点跟进的客户名单。
prompt.en: Segment my customers with RFM, tell me which are key and which may be churning, and export a follow-up list.

prompt.zh: 请分析各产品的销售额和毛利，做 ABC 分类，找出卖得多但不赚钱的产品和长期不动销的产品。
prompt.en: Analyze sales and margin by product, run an ABC classification, and find products that sell but do not earn and products that stopped selling.

description.zh: 拆成销量、结构、价格、新品影响
description.en: Split into volume, mix, price and new items

prompt.zh: 这个月销售额和上个月比变化了，请帮我拆解：多少是因为卖得多或少，多少是产品结构变化，多少是价格变化，多少来自新品或停售的产品。
prompt.en: Sales changed from last month. Break it down into volume, product mix, price, and new or discontinued products.

description.zh: 核心指标、变化原因、问题与建议
description.en: Key numbers, drivers, issues and actions

prompt.zh: 请根据上传的数据写一份销售周报：一句话结论、核心指标对比、变化来自哪里、需要关注的问题和建议，同时生成一份 Excel 汇总表。
prompt.en: Write a weekly sales report from the uploaded data: a one-line summary, key numbers vs last week, what drove the change, issues and suggested actions, plus an Excel summary.

zh: 每周一「09:00」根据上周销售数据生成销售周报，标出变化最大的客户和产品
每月1日「10:00」汇总上月销售额、目标达成和同比，生成 Excel 月报
每个工作日「18:00」统计当天销售额和订单数，与上周同日对比
每周五「17:00」列出超过平均购买间隔两倍未下单的重点客户
每月最后一个工作日「16:00」按当前进度推算本月能否完成目标
每月15日「10:00」更新客户 RFM 分层，导出需要回访的客户名单
en: Every Monday at 09:00, write last week's sales report and flag the customers and products that changed most
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, summarize last month's sales, target attainment and year-on-year change in an Excel report
Every weekday at 18:00, total today's sales and orders and compare with the same day last week
Every Friday at 17:00, list key customers who have not ordered for twice their usual interval
On the last business day of each month at 16:00, project whether this month's target will be met
On the 15th of each month at 10:00, refresh the RFM segments and export the customers to call back
